sections.Profile:
The "Jack 'N Jill" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, featuring artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Nursery Rhyme, Wood Rail, Original Theme
